q: സൗരയൂഥത്തിൽ ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ ശരാശരി സാന്ദ്രതയുള്ള ഗ്രഹം ഏത്?
e: ഗ്രഹങ്ങളിൽ ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ ശരാശരി സാന്ദ്രത ഭൂമിക്കാണ്.

q: 'ഡ്രൈ ഐസ്' എന്നറിയപ്പെടുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
e: ഖരരൂപത്തിലുള്ള കാർബൺ ഡയോക്സൈഡാണ് ഡ്രൈ ഐസ്.

q: വെബ്സൈറ്റുകളിൽ CAPTCHA ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നതിന്റെ പ്രധാന ലക്ഷ്യം എന്ത്?
e: മനുഷ്യനെയും ബോട്ടിനെയും വേർതിരിച്ചറിയാനാണ് CAPTCHA.

q: തെക്കോട്ട് നോക്കി നിൽക്കുന്ന ഒരാൾ ഇടത്തേക്ക് 90° തിരിഞ്ഞ ശേഷം വീണ്ടും ഇടത്തേക്ക് 90° തിരിഞ്ഞാൽ ഏത് ദിശയിലേക്കാണ് നോക്കുന്നത്?
e: തെക്ക് → കിഴക്ക് → വടക്ക്.

q: 34 കുട്ടികളുള്ള ക്ലാസിൽ മീരയുടെ റാങ്ക് മുകളിൽ നിന്ന് 9 ആണ്. താഴെ നിന്ന് മീരയുടെ റാങ്ക് എത്ര?
Pick the word nearest in meaning to TACITURN.
e: Taciturn means reserved in speech.

q: Pick the opposite of PARSIMONIOUS.
e: Parsimonious means stingy; its opposite is lavish.

q: A speech made without any preparation is called ___.
e: A speech made without preparation is impromptu.

q: Fill in the blank: We heard a ___ of wolves howling in the hills.
e: A group of wolves is called a pack.

q: Choose the indirect form of: She said, "I have finished my work."
o: She said that she had finished her work.
She said that I have finished my work.
She told that she finished my work.
She said that she has finish her work.
e: The present perfect changes to past perfect: She said that she had finished her work.

q: Which spelling is right for a system of administration by government officials?
e: The right spelling is bureaucracy.

q: What is the order of the symmetric group S₄?
e: The order of S₄ is 4! = 24.

q: Brewster's law states that for a medium of refractive index n, tan θ_B equals:
e: Brewster's law gives tan θ_B = n.

q: Clemmensen reduction converts a carbonyl group to CH₂ using:
e: Clemmensen reduction uses zinc amalgam and concentrated HCl.

q: According to Hückel's rule, a planar cyclic conjugated ring is aromatic if it has how many π electrons?
e: Hückel's rule requires 4n + 2 π electrons.

q: Okazaki fragments are formed on the:
e: Okazaki fragments are made on the lagging strand during DNA replication.

q: In the Hardy-Weinberg equation, the term 2pq stands for the frequency of:
e: p² and q² are the homozygotes; 2pq is the heterozygote frequency.

q: A machine costing ₹50,000 has a scrap value of ₹5,000 and a life of 9 years. What is the annual straight-line depreciation?
Which item is excluded from current assets when calculating the liquid (quick) ratio?
e: Inventory is excluded when calculating the liquid ratio.

q: Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm is not guaranteed to work on graphs with:
e: Dijkstra's algorithm assumes there are no negative edge weights.

q: Removing transitive dependencies from a relation already in 2NF brings it to:
e: A 2NF relation without transitive dependencies is in 3NF.

q: Who wrote 'Two Treatises of Government'?
e: Two Treatises of Government was written by John Locke.

q: Bernoulli's equation for fluid flow is a statement of the conservation of:
e: Bernoulli's equation expresses the conservation of energy along a streamline.

q: The Sarkaria Commission was set up to examine:
e: The Sarkaria Commission examined Centre-State relations.

q: Who presides over a joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament?
e: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting.

q: Find the next number: 3, 9, 21, 45, ?
e: Each term is the previous × 2 + 3; 45 × 2 + 3 = 93.

q: Pick the word nearest in meaning to GREGARIOUS.
e: Gregarious means sociable.
